dogecoin.text:
@DarrenMcDoge 2. To me, Bitcoin is too rigid.
It lacks flexibility. It lacks spirit.

Dogecoin, on the other hand, feels alive — human, even.
It’s more approachable, more usable, and more fun.
And even on Layer 1, it already works better than a lot of other coins.

Dogecoin isn’t perfect,
but

@DarrenMcDoge 1. I actually agree with Dogecoin.
It feels like a middle ground 
between today’s unlimited inflationary money
and Bitcoin’s extreme deflationary model.

Yes, people say Doge has no supply cap and that’s true.
But what often gets overlooked is that
its issuance is fixed per day
